educationalGoal: In this course, student learn basic programming in Java which is often used in web systems.  Specifically, it contains the followings: understanding the basic of Java that requires  compiling and static typing variables, writing simple programs, and how to execute Java programs.
advice:
Students learn basic of programming with compiling and static typing variables, by using Java with comparing with Python.

Contents of Java:
(1) The basic of writing Java program and executing programs
(2) Concept of variables with typing
(3) The grammar of Java and typical programming method for Java
requiredKnowledge:
The precedent courses: Programming I, II
- Students have to bring own laptop computer, AC adopter, and network cable for software installation, download of course materials, and upload of answer of quizzes

              In this course, student learn basic programming in Java which is often used in web systems.  Specifically, it contains the followings: understanding the basic of Java that requires  compiling and static typing variables, writing simple programs, and how to execute Java programs.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Students learn basic of programming with compiling and static typing variables, by using Java with comparing with Python.

Contents of Java:
(1) The basic of writing Java program and executing programs
(2) Concept of variables with typing
(3) The grammar of Java and typical programming method for Java
